label: Warli
summary: Maharashtra tribal art: white stick figures dancing on earth red
origin: Warli tribe, Palghar and Thane, Maharashtra (India)
history: Painted with rice paste on red-ochre mud walls for weddings and harvests; figures built from circles, triangles and lines. GI-tagged.
look: White stick figures made of two triangles on earth-red — dancing circles (tarpa dance), sun, moon, village and farming life.
fill: Solid white for figures; background left bare

characters.proportions: Two triangles joined at the tip, circle head, line limbs
characters.faces: None — the head is a dot or circle
characters.poses: Dancing in a spiral, farming, carrying pots, hunting

composition.focalPoint: A central spiral of dancers or the sun

motion.feel: Rhythmic loops — dancing circles rotate, figures step

dos: Turn library sprites into white silhouettes
